🇲🇽📉 <u>SAT TAX REVENUE FALLS 1.6% — FIRST CUATRIMESTRE DROP IN 5 YEARS, MANUFACTURING TARIFF SHOCK SHOWING</u>

Federal tax revenue between January and April hit 2.07 trillion pesos — a real 1.6% drop year-over-year and 40.2 billion pesos under the 2026 Federal Income Law projection. It's the first first-cuatrimestre decline since 2021 (the COVID year). ISR alone fell 16% in March and is 55.5 billion under target.

"The ISR signal has a clear connection with economic deceleration," Finamex analyst Víctor Gómez Ayala said. Manufacturing has now contracted four quarters in a row. Meanwhile IVA collection rose 30.1 billion above target and IEPS 7.5 billion above target — proof the consumer base is holding. Trump's tariffs are landing on Mexican factory paychecks, and the 4T is absorbing the hit instead of passing it down.

🇲🇽🌽 <u>"EL MAÍZ ES LA RAÍZ" — SHEINBAUM LAUNCHES NATIVE CORN DEFENSE PLAN, 1M FARMERS BY 2028</u>

President Sheinbaum unveiled "El Maíz es la Raíz" Friday in Jocotitlán — a national plan to protect Mexico's native corn against corporate hybrid-seed takeover. Phase one covers 8 southern and southeastern states with on-the-ground technical teams improving soil quality and yields. Target: 1 million farmers reached by 2028.

A new subprogram "Comaleras del Bienestar" equips women making artisanal tortillas with tools and supplies. "If we don't protect native corn, we end up depending on seed companies," Sheinbaum warned. Food sovereignty isn't a slogan — it's a budget line.

🇲🇽🎓 <u>SEP DEMOCRATIZES THE IPN — STUDENTS, TEACHERS AND WORKERS WILL VOTE FOR THE NEXT DIRECTOR</u>

For the first time in the National Polytechnic Institute's 90-year history, the next director general will be chosen through community consultation — students, faculty and workers all voting. Education Minister Mario Delgado announced the mechanism Friday at the IPN General Advisory Council, paired with a joint strengthening plan with Hacienda that adds teacher hiring and infrastructure funding.

"Democratizar al IPN significa escuchar a las bases, construir con las bases," Delgado said. The 4T is dismantling neoliberal-era appointments — one technical university at a time.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>ICJ EXTENDS SOUTH AFRICA v. ISRAEL GENOCIDE CASE TO 2029 — 6 YEARS ON THE DOCKET</u>

The International Court of Justice has extended the genocide case South Africa filed against Israel through May 2029. South Africa has until November 22, 2027 to file its written reply; Israel has until May 22, 2029 to submit its rejoinder. Tel Aviv had argued the Court lacked jurisdiction — the judges rejected that and kept the case alive.

The original demand was filed December 29, 2023. The world's highest court is now committed to a six-year accountability docket — and a rejoinder phase could push proceedings past 2031.
